magnitude_grid.objective: Minimize expected extension time among immediate-release fixed-reservation rules; not welfare maximization
magnitude_grid.search: 1001-point bonus scan with local refinement; numerical optimization, not a global certificate
magnitude_grid.denominator: Attribution-only time at the minimum immediate-release share, or zero share where release already holds
magnitude_grid.interpretation: Quantiles weight grid cells equally; they are not population frequencies or empirical effect estimates

same_bonus_baseline.selection: Both rules use their own minimum release-supporting share at the same bonus; boundary outcomes are approached with strict release margins
